SELECT a.admin_id, a.login_id, a.admin_nm, a.email, a.mobile_no, a.dept_nm, a.status_cd, c.code_nm AS status_nm, a.login_fail_cnt, a.pwd_temp_yn, a.pwd_changed_dt, a.last_login_dt, ra.admin_nm AS reg_nm, a.reg_dt, ma.admin_nm AS mod_nm, a.mod_dt FROM tb_admin a LEFT JOIN tb_code c ON c.group_cd = 'ADMIN_STATUS' AND c.code = a.status_cd LEFT JOIN tb_admin ra ON ra.admin_id = a.reg_id LEFT JOIN tb_admin ma ON ma.admin_id = a.mod_id WHERE a.admin_id = #{adminId}

SELECT r.role_id, r.role_cd, r.role_nm, r.use_yn, r.system_yn, g.admin_nm AS reg_nm, ar.reg_dt FROM tb_admin_role ar JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id LEFT JOIN tb_admin g ON g.admin_id = ar.reg_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY r.role_id
